name: ocaml-cli
title: OCaml CLI
blurb: OCaml 4.14+ CLI: a pure counting library, a hand-written option parser, a stdlib test suite and a dune workspace with zero dependencies

verify.name: parity
verify.cmd:
printf 'alpha beta
gamma delta
' > .p1.txt && printf 'no trailing newline' > .p2.txt && printf 'h\303\251llo w\303\266rld
' > .p3.txt && : > .p4.txt && for f in .p1.txt .p2.txt .p3.txt .p4.txt; do ours=$(./bin/{{ npm_name }} -l -w -c "$f" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}'); theirs=$(wc -l -w -c "$f" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}'); if [ "$ours" != "$theirs" ]; then echo "MISMATCH $f: ours=[$ours] theirs=[$theirs]"; exit 1; fi; done && rm -f .p1.txt .p2.txt .p3.txt .p4.txt && echo "parity ok"
